title: Complete solubilization of mammalian cells in lysates
author: Bednarska, Malycheva, et al.

steps.title: Seed and treat cells
steps.instruction: Plate 1.5 × 10⁶ U2OS cells per 60 mm dish in six dishes per experiment. Culture overnight. Prepare 2.2 mL treatment medium containing either vehicle (DMSO), 20 µM FCCP, or 20 µM FCCP + 50 nM bafilomycin A1. Remove old medium, add 1 mL treatment medium to each dish, and incubate 3 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Wash and detach cells
steps.instruction: Discard treatment medium. Wash cells twice with 2 mL PBS per dish. Remove PBS. Add 0.5 mL 0.25 % trypsin to each dish and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until cells detach (few minutes, indicated by cloudy trypsin). Stop trypsinisation by adding 2 mL fresh cell medium.

steps.title: Collect and pellet cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cell suspensions into labelled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes. Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Discard supernatant, keep pellets on ice.

steps.title: Resuspend pellets in lysis buffers
steps.instruction: For each treatment, resuspend the pellet from one 60 mm dish in either 150 µL freshly prepared RIPA buffer or 75 µL freshly prepared BADT buffer. Pipette up‑and‑down repeatedly until no clumps remain.

steps.title: Incubate lysates on ice
steps.instruction: Place RIPA‑resuspended tubes on ice for 30 min; place BADT‑resuspended tubes on ice for 5 min. Vortex briefly each tube occasionally to aid solubilisation.

steps.title: Separate soluble and insoluble fractions
steps.instruction: RIPA: after 30 min, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Transfer supernatant to a new tube (RIPA‑soluble fraction). BADT: after 5 min, centrifuge at 1 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Transfer supernatant (label 1) to a new tube and resuspend the pellet in 75 µL 1× NSB buffer. Vortex, incubate on ice 30 min with occasional vortex, then centrifuge again at 1 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Transfer NSB supernatant (label 2).

steps.title: Process RIPA lysates
steps.instruction: Add 38 µL 5× loading buffer to each RIPA‑soluble tube, mix, and heat at 95 °C for 20 min (or 5 min if proteolysis is observed; alternative mild condition 75 °C for 10–15 min).

steps.title: Process BADT/NSB lysates
steps.instruction: Combine the BADT supernatant (label 1) with the NSB supernatant (label 2) for each treatment, vortex, then sonicate using a Soniprep 150 Plus: 3 cycles of 5 s sonication with 3 s pause, amplitude 10. Add 38 µL 5× loading buffer, mix, and heat at 95 °C for 20 min (or adjust as above).

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load 30 µL of each boiled lysate onto a 15 % acrylamide gel.

steps.title: Run gel and transfer proteins
steps.instruction: Perform electrophoresis, then transfer proteins to a 0.22 µm nitrocellulose membrane using a Bio‑Rad Semi‑Dry TransBlot Turbo system according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 % BSA blocking buffer (2.5 g BSA dissolved in 50 mL PBS‑T). Incubate the membrane in blocking buffer for 1 h at room temperature on an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute the chosen primary antibody in PBS‑T (e.g., anti‑γ‑tubulin 1:1000, anti‑LC3 1:1000, anti‑histone 3 1:1000, anti‑ubiquitin 1:400, anti‑actin 1:500, anti‑SLC25A6 1:1000). Incubate membrane overnight at 4 °C on a shaker.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times, 5 min each with PBS‑T. Dilute secondary antibody (mouse IgG HRP‑linked F(ab’)₂ 1:5000 or rabbit IgG HRP‑linked 1:5000) in PBS‑T and incubate 1 h at room temperature on a shaker. Wash again three times, 5 min each with PBS‑T.

steps.title: Develop and image membrane
steps.instruction: Apply WesternBright Sirius HRP‑substrate according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Capture chemiluminescent signal using a Bio‑Rad ChemiDoc imaging system.

steps.title: Strip and re‑probe (optional)
steps.instruction: Strip the membrane with 1× ReBlot Plus Strong Antibody Stripping Solution as instructed. Wash twice, 5 min each with PBS‑T. Re‑incubate with a different primary antibody and repeat the secondary, wash, and development steps.

steps.title: Densitometry analysis in Fiji
steps.instruction: Open the acquired image in Fiji. Convert to 8‑bit (Image > Type > 8‑bit). Use the rectangle tool to select the strongest band, then choose Analyze > Measure to obtain mean intensity. Move the rectangle to a background area and measure again. Calibrate (Analyze > Calibrate) setting the highest band mean to 1 and the lowest to 0. Apply the calibrated settings to measure all bands of interest, recording each mean value.

substeps.instruction: Select strongest band with rectangle tool.
Calibrate using measured values (set high = 1, low = 0).
Measure each band of interest with calibrated settings.
